title: Cover the corrupt-base proof gaps the #51 Stage 1 review found
description:
Filed at the leader's instruction on 2026-10-20 from the Stage 1 verdict on opum-ai/test-skills#51 (TS-36, DEC-213 (a2)), which is recorded verbatim on the completed TS-36 record. The verdict is APPROVE; these are its two MINOR findings that did not block. Its one NIT (finding 3) is noted there and needs no change.

1. MINOR, tests/test_gate.py:341-356. The probation corrupt-base proof only covers the failing arm (uncertified_demotion plus the info naming the file). No test shows a corrupt probation base with a compliant head (matrix supplied) passing. The code path is the same `_load_base_list` call the quarantine test already covers pass-and-names-file for, so the risk is low.

2. MINOR, tests/test_gate_matrix.py:56-73 (pre-existing, from TS-30). The corrupt-head proofs call `gate.run` with no base. Nothing exercises a corrupt head together with a base, or both copies corrupt. By reading gate.py:421-436 both cases behave correctly: the head violation is added, the base is read as empty, and the info names the unreadable base file. They are untested only.

TS-36 has since landed on dev as 2352287 (squash of #51), so these are gaps in code already on dev, not a blocker on a pending change.

SLOTS: fold both proofs into the existing git-fixture cases where the shapes allow. Any new collected case is a measured slot request through the leader under DEC-195's bar, and the cap stays 95.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A corrupt probation base with a compliant head (matrix supplied) is proved to pass with no violation, with the run's info naming the unreadable base file.

A corrupt head together with a base is covered for both kinds: the head violation fires by name and the base is read as empty with the info naming the unreadable base file; the both-copies-corrupt case is covered or its absence is recorded with a reason.
The proof adds no collected test case beyond the 95 baseline, or every case it adds carries a leader-approved measured slot request.

finalSummary: Folded the two Stage 1 MINOR proofs into existing cases in tests/test_gate.py, adding no collected case: -m "not slow" still collects and passes 95 (the 103 total includes the 8 slow, unchanged). (1) probation: a corrupt base with a compliant head (matrix supplied) now passes with no violation and the info names the unreadable base file. (2) new helper _assert_corrupt_head_is_named_with_a_base, called from the quarantine and probation tests: a corrupt head fails by name (unreadable_state_file) against a valid base, and against a corrupt base too, where the base is read as empty and named in info; absent for the valid base. The both-copies-corrupt case is covered. Mutation: making _load_base_list re-raise turned both edited tests red. Evidence is local, run under Python 3.12 via uv; the PR run is cited at the head.
